grammar_focus: 过去进行时(was/were+V-ing · 用法过去某时正在进行 · when背景+突发一般过去 · while双进行 · vs一般过去时 · 否定/疑问)
scene: 侦探们在机场守候一批贵重钻石包裹 · 打开却发现里面全是石头和沙子

grammar_card.title: 说"过去正在做"的事(过去进行时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"过去某个时刻正在进行"的动作。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 构成:was/were + 动词-ing(I/he/she/it → was;you/we/they → were)
The detectives were waiting. / A guard was opening the parcel.
用法:表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作
At that moment, everyone was holding their breath.
背景(过去进行时,历时较长)+ 突发(一般过去时,短暂),常用 when 连接
Some detectives were watching when the plane landed.
while + 两个过去进行时,表示两件事同时进行
While one guard was keeping watch, another was opening the parcel.

specialRules.rule: 常用时间连词:when(当…时)/ while(在…期间,后面多接进行时)/ as(一边…一边)/ just as(正当…时)
'正在进行的背景'用过去进行时,'突然发生的一下'用一般过去时;两者常在同一句里配合

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was inside the parcel in the end?

passage: It was a cold, rainy afternoon at the airport. The detectives were waiting near the gate all afternoon. They were expecting a shipment of valuable diamonds from overseas. That morning, a caller warned them that thieves were planning to steal it. When the plane landed, some detectives were watching the main hall. Others were standing outside on the airfield. Two workers carried the parcel into a small office. While one guard was keeping watch at the door, another was opening the parcel. Everyone was holding their breath. Then a detective slowly cut the precious parcel open. To their surprise, it was full of gray stones and sand!
